newsitem.title: TUNISIA: FORECAST- Tunisian 1996 growth seen at 7 pct -WB.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST- Tunisian 1996 growth seen at 7 pct -WB.

text.p: Tunisia's gross domestic product (GDP) is expected to grow by seven percent in 1996, Uri Dadush, an economist at the World Bank, said on Monday.
The figure is down from a Tunisian government forecast last month of 7.5 to eight percent, but higher than an earlier budget forecast of 6.7 percent.

"This year's forecasts...showed that the growth rate would be an almost all-time record of seven percent," Dadush told a seminar on "the globalisation of the economy and the countries of the Mediterranean" in Tunis.
